description: Every Rudder Cloud home at a glance: memory, disk, agents, disconnects and what the scaler wants to do.

panels.description: Home machines that sent metrics in the last 5 minutes. If this is lower than the running homes on the control plane page, a home went silent: the scaler raises investigate-silent for it.
panels.title: Homes reporting

panels.description: Homes where every task was stalled on memory for at least 10% of the last minute. Red means a home is thrashing and its terminals are about to drop: open it from the Homes table, see what holds the memory, and let the cleanup or the scaler act.
panels.title: Under memory pressure

panels.description: Homes with less than 10% free on /workspace. Red means checkouts and builds will start failing: extend the volume (the scaler recommends extend-volume).

targets.expr: count(max by (rudder_home_id) (rudder_home_disk_free_bytes{mount="/workspace",rudder_home_id=~"$home"}) / max by (rudder_home_id) (rudder_home_disk_total_bytes{mount="/workspace",rudder_home_id=~"$home"}) < 0.1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Low on disk

panels.description: Times the control plane saw a home's control socket close in the last hour. Each one shows "Cloud machine reconnecting" in every attached terminal. Amber or red: find the home in the Homes table and check its memory stall and supervisor event loop.
panels.title: Disconnects, last hour

panels.description: Agents in a live turn across the selected homes.
panels.title: Agents working

panels.description: Agents with a live process and no turn. They hold memory; the hourly cleanup puts the ones nobody has touched to sleep. A climbing count with no asleep agents means the cleanup is not running.
panels.title: Agents idle

panels.description: Agents the cleanup parked. They keep their conversation and workspace and wake on the next message.
panels.title: Agents asleep

panels.description: Dry run means the scaler only recommends. Applying means it may resize machines and extend volumes (RUDDER_SCALER_APPLY=1). Not reporting means Prometheus cannot scrape the scaler.
panels.title: Scaler mode

panels.description: One row per home, worst memory first. A - means the home sent no value (stopped reporting, or no such disk). Amber and red cells need attention: low memory or high stall means the home is close to dropping its terminals, low disk means builds will fail, a slow event loop means the supervisor is starving. Click a home to open its page.

panels.title: Homes

panels.description: Share of the last minute every task on the home waited for memory (PSI full avg60). Above the amber line the home counts as under pressure; above the red line the cleanup runs early. A home that stays above red needs more memory: see the Scaling section.
panels.title: Memory stall by home

panels.description: Memory the kernel can hand out without swapping, as a share of the machine. Below the red line the home is close to the OOM state of 2026-11-02; the cleanup runs early below 12%.
panels.title: Memory available by home

panels.description: Live agents across the selected homes. Working and waiting hold a turn; idle agents hold memory for nothing until the cleanup puts them to sleep. A tall idle band with no asleep band means the cleanup is not keeping up.
panels.title: Agents by state

panels.description: Control socket closes the control plane saw, in 5 minute buckets. Each bar is a "Cloud machine reconnecting" banner for that home's users. Repeated bars on one home usually follow memory stall on the chart above.
panels.title: Disconnects by home, per 5 minutes

panels.description: Seconds since the scaler last evaluated the fleet. It runs every minute; red means it stopped and nothing is watching the homes. Check the rudder-scaler process and its logs.
panels.title: Last scaler evaluation

panels.description: Evaluations that failed in the last hour, usually because Prometheus did not answer. Red means the scaler is blind: check that Prometheus is up.
panels.title: Scaler errors, last hour

panels.description: Homes the scaler wants something done for. The table below says what and why it has not happened yet.
panels.title: Homes with a decision

panels.description: Memory resizes the scaler holds back because agents are mid turn on that home. A resize restarts the machine, so it waits until nothing is working or waiting.
panels.title: Resizes waiting for idle

panels.description: Every current decision. Recommended means a person (or the scaler in apply mode) should act; waiting-for-idle means the home is busy; cooldown means it acted recently; failed means the Fly API refused, so check the scaler logs. Empty means the scaler sees nothing to do.

targets.expr: max by (rudder_home_id, action, state) (rudder_scaler_decision{rudder_home_id=~"$home"} == 1) * on (rudder_home_id) group_left () max by (rudder_home_id) (rudder_home_memory_total_bytes{rudder_home_id=~"$home"})

max by (rudder_home_id, action, state) (rudder_scaler_decision{action=~"scale-up-memory|scale-down-memory",rudder_home_id=~"$home"} == 1) * on (rudder_home_id) group_left () max by (rudder_home_id) (rudder_scaler_target_memory_bytes{rudder_home_id=~"$home"})

max by (rudder_home_id, action, state) (rudder_scaler_decision{rudder_home_id=~"$home"} == 1) * on (rudder_home_id) group_left () sum by (rudder_home_id) (max by (rudder_home_id, state) (rudder_home_agents{state=~"working|waiting",rudder_home_id=~"$home"}))
